subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff and executive sponsor intro - Acme Therapeutics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Gupta <rgupta@acmetx.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmetx.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-19T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff and executive sponsor intro - Acme Therapeutics

Hi Rajesh / Samantha —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, I’m starting a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can align on success criteria, timeline, and escalation paths for the evaluation and potential production rollout. I’m copying the core Redwood team so roles are clear from the outset.

High-level proposal (MAP v0.1 attached):
- Evaluation window: 2-week PoC (feature/key flows), followed by 2-week extended validation phase if needed.
- Success metrics: 99th pct latency target, inference cost envelope, and functional pass/fail on the three pilot endpoints we discussed.
- Executive sponsor: we’d like a single exec sponsor (VP/CTO-level) to enable prioritization and rapid decisions.
- Escalation path: Sponsor -> Marissa (account lead) -> Markus (Sales VP) -> Redwood CTO on call.

Next steps I’d like to confirm:
1) Executive sponsor: can you confirm who will sign on as sponsor for the MAP?
2) Kickoff meeting: 30–45 min with sponsor, VP Product (Samantha), engineering lead, procurement, and our SE (David) — propose Tue Feb 24 or Wed Feb 25.
3) Share any required compliance docs upfront (SOC 2 scope, data residency notes) so we can include them in the MAP.

I’ve attached Acme_MAP_v0.1.pdf (one-page summary) and a draft SLA doc for reference. If that looks good I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read.

Attaching: Acme_MAP_v0.1.pdf (summary), Proposed_SLA_Redwood.docx

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

From: Rajesh Gupta <rgupta@acmetx.com>

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff and executive sponsor intro - Acme Therapeutics

Marissa —

Thanks for pulling this together. I’m happy to serve as executive sponsor for Acme on this engagement. A couple priorities to call out early so they’re baked into the MAP:
- Data privacy / PIIs segmentation: we will require clear data residency and retention terms within the POC.
- Latency: our target for interactive use is 99th percentile under 250ms for the core retrieval+inference flow.
- Procurement: we’ll need a short pilot commercial term sheet for legal review (cc’d procurement).

I’m available Wed Feb 25 between 10:00–11:30am PT or Thu Feb 26 after 1pm PT for the kickoff. If you want an initial 15–20 min sync with me and Samantha before bringing in procurement, happy to do that.

Great — thanks everyone.

I booked the kickoff for Wed, Feb 25 at 10:15–11:00am PT (calendar invite sent) — agenda: 10:15–10:30 exec alignment (Rajesh, Samantha), 10:30–11:00 technical & procurement (David, procurement rep).

Attached I’ve uploaded an updated MAP (Acme_MAP_v0.1.pdf) with a short checklist and the Proposed_SLA_Redwood.docx. A few items for the meeting:
- Rajesh: can you confirm the internal engineering lead who will join the technical portion?
- Procurement: if you can share the preferred NDA/PO terms or a simple Pilot SOW template ahead of the meeting that will speed review.
- Exec ask: please review the 3 proposed executive-level success metrics in the MAP and confirm any additions. Example metrics we included: 1) 99th pct latency <250ms, 2) end-to-end integration completeness for two key endpoints, 3) documented runbook for escalation.

If anything changes on scheduling I’ll update the invite. Looking forward to the kickoff.
